DURR-FULL:v6p466/r5.speaker: الحسن
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r5.claim: Al-Hasan says God's remembrance of people when they remember Him is greater than their remembrance of Him.
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r5.anchor: عن الحسن {ولذكر الله أكبر} يقول: لذكر الله إياكم إذا ذكرتموه أكبر من ذكركم إياه

DURR-FULL:v6p466/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r6.speaker: أبو قرة
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r6.claim: Abu Qurra tells Jabir that God's remembrance is greater than people's remembrance of Him.
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r6.anchor: عن جابر قال: سألت أبا قرة عن قوله {ولذكر الله أكبر} قال: ذكر الله أكبر من ذكركم إياه

DURR-FULL:v6p466/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas again says God's remembrance of people is greater than their remembrance of Him, mentioning remembrance when He forbade something.
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r7.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما في قوله {ولذكر الله} عندما حرمه وذكر الله إياكم أعظم من ذكركم إياه

DURR-FULL:v6p466/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r8.speaker: أبو مالك
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r8.claim: Abu Malik says God's remembrance of the servant during prayer is greater than the prayer itself.
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r8.anchor: عن أبي مالك رضي الله عنه {ولذكر الله أكبر} قال: ذكر الله العبد في الصلاة أكبر من الصلاة

DURR-FULL:v6p466/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r9.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r9.claim: Qatada says nothing is greater than the remembrance of God.
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r9.anchor: عن قتادة رضي الله عنه في قوله {ولذكر الله أكبر} قال: لا شيء أكبر من ذكر الله

DURR-FULL:v6p466/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r10.speaker: معاذ بن جبل
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r10.claim: Muʿadh b. Jabal says no human act saves better from God's punishment than remembrance; he says this surpasses even fighting until one's sword breaks, citing the verse.
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r10.anchor: عن معاذ بن جبل رضي الله عنه قال: ما عمل آدمي عملا أنجى له من عذاب الله من ذكر الله

DURR-FULL:v6p466/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r11.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r11.claim: Asked by Anṭara for the best deed, Ibn Abbas answers remembrance of God and adds that people studying the Qur'an in a mosque are sheltered by angels, God's guests, while knowledge-seekers are guided toward Paradise.
DURR-FULL:v6p466/r11.anchor: عن عنترة قال: قلت لابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: أي العمل أفضل قال: ذكر الله أكبر

DURR-FULL:v6p467/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r1.speaker: أبو الدرداء
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r1.claim: Abu al-Darda called remembrance of God the best deed: better than meeting and fighting an enemy or giving gold and silver, and most beloved to God and elevating in rank.
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r1.anchor: قالوا: وما هو يا أبا الدرداء قال: ذكر الله {ولذكر الله أكبر}

DURR-FULL:v6p467/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r2.speaker: أم الدرداء
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r2.claim: Umm al-Darda says prayer, fasting, every good deed, and abstaining from evil all count as remembrance of God; glorifying God is better still.
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r2.anchor: عن أم الدرداء رضي الله عنها قالت {ولذكر الله أكبر} وإن صليت فهو من ذكر الله

DURR-FULL:v6p467/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r3.speaker: سلمان
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r3.claim: Salman answers that nothing is better than remembrance of God, citing the verse when asked which deed is best.
DURR-FULL:v6p467/r3.anchor: عن سلمان رضي الله عنه أنه سئل أي العمل أفضل قال: أما تقرأ القرآن {ولذكر الله أكبر}

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r1.speaker: الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r1.claim: Al-Hasan explains al-kitab as the Qur'an.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r1.anchor: عن الحسن قوله : الكتاب قال : القران .

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r2.speaker: رسول الله ﷺ
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r2.claim: Asked about the verse, the Prophet says that one whose prayer does not restrain him from indecency and wrongdoing has no prayer.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r2.anchor: عن عمران بن حصين قال : سئل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، عن قول الله : ان الصلاة تنهى ، عن الفحشاء والمنكر قال : من لم تنهه صلاته

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r3.speaker: رسول الله ﷺ
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas attributes to the Prophet the saying that whoever is not restrained by prayer from indecency and wrongdoing only grows farther from God.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، من لم تنهه صلاته ، عن الفحشاء والمنكر لم يزد بها من الله الا بعدا .

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r4.speaker: عبده
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r4.claim: Abda reports the Prophet saying that prayer which does not restrain from wrongdoing is no prayer; Abu Khalid also transmits the saying from Abdullah.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r4.anchor: عن عبده قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وقال ابو خالد مرة ، عن عبد الله لا صلاة لم تنهه الصلاة

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r5.speaker: عبد الله
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r5.claim: Abdullah says prayer benefits the person who obeys it, in response to mention of someone who prays at length.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r5.anchor: عن عبد الله بن يزيد قال : قيل لعبد الله : ان فلانا يطيل الصلاة قال : ان الصلاة تنفع الامر اطاعها

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas says prayer contains a restraint and deterrent from disobeying God.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : ان الصلاة تنهى ، عن الفحشاء والمنكر يقول : في الصلاة منتهى ومزدجر ، عن معاصي الله .

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r7.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r7.speaker: أبو العالية
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r7.claim: Abu al-Aliya says prayer has three elements—sincerity, reverent fear, and remembrance of God—and each directs the worshipper toward good and away from wrong.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3065#2/r7.anchor: عن ابي العالية في قوله : ان الصلاة تنهى ، عن الفحشاء والمنكر ان الصلاة فيها ثلاث خلال

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r1.speaker: أبو غوث
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r1.claim: Abu Ghawth says that while one is praying, one is engaged in good and held back from indecency and wrongdoing; the remembrance within prayer is greater.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r1.anchor: عن ابي غوث قوله : ان الصلاة تنهى ، عن الفحشاء والمنكر قال : اذا كنت في صلاة فانت في معروف وقد حجزتك

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r2.speaker: حماد بن أبي سليمان
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r2.claim: Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman explains that prayer restrains a person for as long as the person is within it.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r2.anchor: حدثنا حماد بن أبي سليمان في قول الله : ان الصلاة تنهى ، عن الفحشاء والمنكر قال : ما دمت فيها .

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r3.speaker: ابن عباس، عكرمة، الحسن
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies indecency as adultery and wrongdoing as associating partners with God; the same gloss is reported from Ikrima and al-Hasan.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس تنهى ، عن الفحشاء والمنكر يقول : الزنا والمنكر الشرك . وروي ، عن عكرمة والحسن مثل ذلك .

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r4.speaker: عبد الله بن ربيعة
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r4.claim: Abdullah ibn Rabi'a first suggests that the phrase means remembering God when facing sins.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r4.anchor: عن عبد الله بن ربيعة قال : قال ابن عباس : ما تقول في قول الله : ولذكر الله اكبر

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas rejects that suggestion and says God's remembrance of the servant is greater than the servant's remembrance of God.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r5.anchor: فقال ابن عباس : لقد قلت وما هو كما قلت ، ولكن ذكر الله العبد اكبر من ذكر العبد لربه .

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas says to remember God at meals and at bedtime; he accepts that God's remembering people is greater than their remembering Him, citing God's promise to remember those who remember Him.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس ولذكر الله اكبر قال : ذكر الله ، عند طعامك ، عند منامك

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r7.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas says God's remembrance of His servants when they remember Him is greater than their remembrance of Him.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r7.anchor: عن ابن عباس ولذكر الله اكبر يقول : ولذكر الله لعباده اذا ذكروه اكبر من ذكرهم اياه .

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r8.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r8.claim: Asked for the best deed, Ibn Abbas repeats three times that God's remembrance is greatest; he adds that remembrance circles in mosques are attended by angels, and God eases the path to Paradise for seekers of knowledge, while lineage cannot make up for deeds.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3066/r8.anchor: سالت ابن عباس او سئل اي العمل افضل قال : ولذكر الله اكبر وبه قال : ذلك ثلاث مرات

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3068/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3068/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3068/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas says the phrase has two readings: remembering God when His prohibitions arise, and God's remembrance of people being greater than their remembrance of Him.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3068/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله : ولذكر الله اكبر قال : لها وجهان . قال : ذكر الله ، عندما حرمة قال : ذكر الله اياكم اعظم من ذكركم اياه

IBNABIHATIM:v9p3068/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3068/r2.speaker: مجاهد
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3068/r2.claim: Mujahid says God's remembrance of the servant is greater than the servant's remembrance of his Lord in prayer and outside it.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p3068/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد قوله : ولذكر الله عبده اكبر من ذكر العبد ربه في الصلاة وغيرها .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r2.claim: After presenting earlier peoples as an example, the passage clarifies the falsehood of the polytheists’ creed and praises believers’ sound belief, then addresses the Messenger to strengthen him in preaching and observance and benefit believers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r2.anchor: بعد أن ضرب الله للناس المثل بالأمم السالفة جاء بالحجة المبينة فساد معتقد المشركين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r3.claim: The command strengthens the Messenger in spreading the call, observing religious duties, and proclaiming God’s word; believers who benefited from proofs of unity share its benefit.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r3.anchor: أقبل على رسوله بالخطاب الذي يزيد تثبيته على نشر الدعوة وملازمة الشرائع

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r4.claim: The Messenger is the believers’ exemplar and leader, so the command extends to them, as confirmed by its plural ending and 11:112.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r4.anchor: وما الرسول عليه الصلاة والسلام إلا قدوة للمؤمنين وسيدهم فأمره أمر لهم كما دل عليه التذييل بقوله { والله يعلم ما تصنعون } بصيغة جمع المخاطبين كقوله { فاستقم كما أمرت ومن تاب معك } ( هود : 112 )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r5.claim: The object of اتل is omitted so recitation includes addressing both Muslims and polytheists, as in 27:91–92.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r5.anchor: وحذف متعلق فعل { اتل } ليعم التلاوة على المسلمين وعلى المشركين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r6.claim: Prayer is a great deed; this command also applies to the whole community, since establishing prayer is repeatedly commanded throughout the Qur’an.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r6.anchor: وأمره بإقامة الصلاة لأن الصلاة عمل عظيم ، وهذا الأمر يشمل الأمة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r7.claim: إن functions like a causal فاء here, explaining the command to establish prayer.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r7.anchor: وعلل الأمر بإقامة الصلاة بالإشارة إلى ما فيها من الصلاح النفساني

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r8.claim: The reasoning chiefly addresses the community, since the Prophet is protected from indecency; the verse explains prayer’s benefit but not the command to recite, because this benefit is a divine secret learned through revelation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p257/r8.anchor: ولا شك أن هذا التعليل موجه إلى الأمة لأن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم معصوم من الفحشاء والمنكر فاقتصر على تعليل الأمر بإقامة الصلاة دون تعليل الأمر بتلاوة القرآن لما في هذا الصلاح الذي جعله الله في الصلاة من سر إلهي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r1.claim: Standing, bowing, and prostration express humility before God and remind worshippers to seek His pleasure and avoid His anger, deterring indecency and wrong.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r1.anchor: وفي الصلاة أفعال هي خضوع وتذلل لله تعالى من قيام وركوع وسجود وذلك يذكر بلزوم اجتلاب مرضاته والتباعد عن سخطه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r2.claim: Prayer’s inward acts of intention and readiness to stand before God remind worshippers to obey His commands and avoid His prohibitions.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r2.anchor: وفي الصلاة أعمال قلبية من نية واستعداد للوقوف بين يدي الله وذلك يذكر بأن المعبود جدير بأن تمتثل أوامره وتجتنب نواهيه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r3.claim: Through its combined acts, prayer functions as an admonisher; saying it prohibits sin portrays moral counsel rather than forceful diversion or restraint.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r3.anchor: فكانت الصلاة بمجموعها كالواعظ الناهي عن الفحشاء والمنكر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r4.claim: People vary in response, and prayer is distributed through day and night to renew reminders; repetition strengthens piety until it becomes a settled trait, with a further divine property easing avoidance of sin.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r5.speaker: أبو هريرة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r5.claim: Abu Hurayra reports that a man told the Prophet someone prayed at night but stole in the morning; the Prophet replied that the prayer would soon stop him. No grading is stated.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r5.anchor: روى أحمد وابن حبان والبيهقي عن أبي هريرة قال : ( جاء رجل إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال : إن فلانا يصلي بالليل فإذا أصبح سرق ، فقال : سينهاه ما تقول ) أي صلاته بالليل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r6.claim: The definite article marks the generic classes; whenever prayer recalls God’s greatness, duty, and possible sins, it restrains the worshipper from some instances.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r6.anchor: واعلم أن التعريف في قوله { الفحشاء والمنكر } تعريف الجنس فكلما تذكر المصلي عند صلاته عظمة ربه ووجوب طاعته وذكر ما قد يفعله من الفحشاء والمنكر كانت صلاته حينئذ قد نهته عن بعض أفراد الفحشاء والمنكر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r7.claim: Faḥshāʾ denotes an act exceeding an accepted limit; here it means speech or action beyond what religious law permits, as in 2:169.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r7.anchor: و { الفحشاء } : اسم للفاحشة ، والفحش : تجاوز الحد المقبول

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r8.claim: Munkar means whatever religious law rejects and does not approve.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r8.anchor: وبالمنكر : ما ينكره الشرع ولا يرضى بوقوعه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r9.claim: The two terms are paired because they express distinct grounds for condemnation and prohibition.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p259/r9.anchor: وكأن الجمع بين الفاحشة والمنكر منظور فيه إلى اختلاف جهة ذمه والنهي عنه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r1.claim: The clause may coordinate with the claim that prayer prohibits wrongdoing; dhikr then means prayer, as in 62:9.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r1.anchor: يجوز أن يكون عطفا على جملة { إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r2.claim: On that reading, prayer prohibits wrongdoing because it is God’s remembrance; أكبر conveys intensity rather than comparison.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r2.anchor: أي إنما كانت ناهية عن الفحشاء والمنكر لأنها ذكر الله وذكر الله أمر كبير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r3.claim: Alternatively, the clause coordinates with the command to recite, and ذكر الله means recalling God’s greatness; the superlative is noncomparative.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r3.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون عطفا على جملة { اتل ما أوحي إليك من الكتاب } . والمعنى : واذكر الله فإن ذكر الله أمر عظيم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r4.claim: Alternatively, dhikr means verbal remembrance, in prayer and beyond; the sense resembles Muʿadh ibn Jabal’s statement that no human deed saves more from punishment than remembering God.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r4.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون المراد ذكر الله باللسان ليعم ذكر الله في الصلاة وغيرها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r5.speaker: معاذ بن جبل
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r5.claim: Muʿadh ibn Jabal says no deed a person performs is more saving from God’s punishment than remembrance of God.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r5.anchor: ويكون في معنى قول معاذ بن جبل ( ما عمل آدمي عملا أنجى له من عذاب الله من ذكر الله )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r6.claim: A third reading takes dhikr as remembering God’s commands and prohibitions, vigilance and fear of His anger; here greater is genuinely comparative, since this remembrance can be repeated more often and restrains sin more than prayer.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r6.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون المراد بالذكر تذكر ما أمر الله به ونهى عنه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r7.speaker: عمر رضي الله عنه
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r7.claim: Umar says that remembering God when facing His commands and prohibitions is better than thanking Him with the tongue.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r7.anchor: قريبا من قول عمر رضي الله عنه : أفضل من شكر الله باللسان ذكر الله عند أمره ونهيه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r8.claim: A fourth reading is that remembrance means belief in God’s existence and oneness, the foundation underlying the two commanded good deeds; faith is the greater root.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r8.anchor: ذكر الله هو الإيمان بوجوده وبأنه واحد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r9.claim: This returns from the commanded acts to the chapter’s condemnation of shirk and glorification of monotheism, beginning from 29:42.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p260/r9.anchor: وذلك من رد العجز على الصدر عاد به إلى تعظيم أمر التوحيد وتفظيع الشرك من قوله { إن الله يعلم ما تدعون من دونه من شيء } ( العنكبوت : 42 ) إلى هنا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p261/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p261/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p261/r1.claim: The closing clause summarizes the preceding commands and warning; it promises and threatens in light of recitation, prayer, and avoidance of wrongdoing.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p261/r1.anchor: وقوله { والله يعلم ما تصنعون } تذييل لما قبله

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r3.claim: God commands the Prophet to carry out His command and recite the revealed Qur'an.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r3.anchor: ثم أمر تعالى نبيه عليه السلام بالنفوذ لأمره وتلاوة القرآن

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r4.claim: Establishing prayer means maintaining it and observing its limits.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r4.anchor: وإقامة الصلاة أي إدامتها والقيام بحدودها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r5.claim: Prayer restrains its practitioner from indecency and wrongdoing when performed with humility, remembrance, and awareness of standing before God's majesty; this reforms the self and its actions.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r5.anchor: وذلك عندي بأن المصلي إذا كان على الواجب من الخشوع والإخبات

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r6.speaker: بعض السلف
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r6.claim: An early Muslim is reported to tremble and turn pale at prayer, saying that standing before the King of kings warrants greater awe than worldly kings.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r6.anchor: وقد روي عن بعض السلف أنه كان إذا قام إلى الصلاة ارتعد واصفر لونه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r7.claim: Prayer performed with this reverence necessarily restrains wrongdoing; prayer that only meets minimum validity leaves a sinner in his prior state.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r7.anchor: فهذه صلاة تنهى ولا بد عن الفحشاء والمنكر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r8.speaker: ابن مسعود وابن عباس والحسن والأعمش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r8.claim: These authorities say prayer that does not stop indecency increases a person only in distance from God.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r8.anchor: الحديث المروي عن ابن مسعود وابن عباس والحسن والأعمش قولهم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r9.speaker: الحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r9.claim: Al-Ḥasan also transmitted this as a mursal report from the Prophet, but Ibn ʿAṭiyya says its chain is unsound.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r9.anchor: وقد روي أن الحسن أرسله عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وذلك غير صحيح السند

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r10.claim: The report does not mean the prayer itself is sinful; weak prayer fails to bring its owner nearer and leaves him persisting in sins that distance him.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r10.anchor: فغير جائز أن نقول إن نفس صلاة العاصي تبعده من الله

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r11.speaker: ابن مسعود
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r11.claim: When told someone prayed often, Ibn Masʿūd said prayer benefits only one who obeys it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r11.anchor: فقال: إنها لا تنفع إلا من أطاعها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r12.speaker: الربيع بن أنس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r12.claim: Al-Rabīʿ ibn Anas reads that prayer commands right and prohibits indecency and wrongdoing.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r12.anchor: وقرأ الربيع بن أنس «إن الصلاة تأمر بالمعروف وتنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r13.speaker: ابن عمر
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p319#2/r13.claim: Ibn ʿUmar says “prayer” here refers to the Qur'an.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r1.speaker: حماد بن أبي سليمان وابن جريج والكلبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r1.claim: Ḥammād ibn Abī Sulaymān, Ibn Jurayj, and al-Kalbī say prayer restrains only while one is performing it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r1.anchor: وقال حماد بن أبي سليمان وابن جريج والكلبي: إن الصلاة تنهى ما دمت فيها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r2.claim: Anas reports that an Anṣārī youth prayed with the Prophet yet committed indecency and theft; the Prophet said prayer would stop him, and the youth soon repented.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r2.anchor: مما روى أنس بن مالك قال: كان فتى من الأنصار

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya rejects “only while praying”: the Anas report shows prayer can bring later reform outside the prayer itself.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r3.anchor: فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «ألم أقل لكم»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r4.speaker: ابن عباس وأبو الدرداء وسلمان وابن مسعود وأبو قرة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r4.claim: These authorities say God's remembering you is greater than your remembering Him.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r4.anchor: قال ابن عباس وأبو الدرداء وسلمان وابن مسعود وأبو قرة: معناه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r5.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r5.claim: Another interpretation says persistent remembrance of God exceeds prayer in restraining indecency.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r5.anchor: وقيل معناه ولذكر الله أكبر مع المداومة من الصلاة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r6.speaker: ابن زيد وقتادة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r6.claim: Ibn Zayd and Qatada say remembrance of God is greater than everything.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r6.anchor: قال ابن زيد وقتادة معناه ولذكر الله أكبر من كل شيء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r7.speaker: سلمان
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r7.claim: Asked which deed is best, Salman cites “the remembrance of God is greater.”
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r7.anchor: وقيل لسلمان أي الأعمال أفضل؟ فقال: أما تقرأ القرآن

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r8.speaker: أبو الدرداء
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r8.claim: A report in the Muwaṭṭaʾ from Abū al-Dardāʾ begins, “Shall I tell you the best of your deeds?”
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r8.anchor: ومنه حديث الموطأ عن أبي الدرداء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r9.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya prefers the unrestricted sense: God's remembrance itself restrains wrongdoing, in and outside prayer.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r9.anchor: وعندي أن المعنى ولذكر الله أكبر على الإطلاق

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r10.claim: The part of remembrance in prayer has this effect, as does remembrance outside prayer; desistance requires a remembering, watchful person.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r10.anchor: فالجزء الذي منه في الصلاة يفعل ذلك وكذلك يفعل في غير الصلاة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r11.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r11.claim: A hadith says that whoever remembers God in a gathering will be remembered by Him in a better gathering.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r11.anchor: ومن ذكرني في ملإ ذكرته في ملإ خير منه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r12.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r12.claim: Prayer's physical movements do not restrain; useful remembrance requires knowledge, an attentive heart, and devotion, while tongue-only remembrance is lower.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r12.anchor: والحركات التي في الصلاة لا تأثير لها في نهي

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r13.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r13.claim: God's remembrance of the servant is an infusion of guidance and knowledge's light, the fruit of the servant remembering Him, as in 2:152.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r13.anchor: وذكر الله تعالى العبد هو إفاضة الهدى ونور العلم عليه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r14.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r14.claim: The rest is a warning and exhortation to watchfulness.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p320/r14.anchor: وباقي الآية ضرب من التوعد والحث على المراقبة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r1.speaker: الأكثرون
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r1.claim: Most scholars understand prayer here as the familiar ritual prayer.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r1.anchor: في المراد بالصلاة قولان أحدهما أنها الصلاة المعروفة قاله الأكثرون

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r2.speaker: أنس بن مالك عن رسول الله ( ص )
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r2.claim: The Prophet said that prayer which fails to restrain its performer from indecency only increases that person's distance from God; no grading is stated.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r2.anchor: وروى أنس بن مالك عن رسول الله ( ص ) أنه قال من لم تنهه صلاته عن الفحشاء والمنكر

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r3.speaker: ابن عمر
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r3.claim: Ibn Umar interprets prayer in this verse as the Quran, citing the command not to recite one's prayer aloud.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r3.anchor: والثاني أن المراد بالصلاة القرآن قاله ابن عمر

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r4.claim: Ibn al-Jawzi directs readers to his earlier explanations of indecency and wrongdoing in al-Baqara and al-Nahl.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r4.anchor: وقد شرحنا معنى الفحشاء والمنكر فيما سبق البقرة النحل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r5.speaker: العلماء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r5.claim: One scholarly view is that prayer properly performed, with reflection on its recitation, ought to restrain a person from wrongdoing.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r5.anchor: أن الإنسان إذا أدى الصلاة كما ينبغي وتدبر ما يتلو فيها نهته عن الفحشاء والمنكر

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r6.speaker: العلماء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r6.claim: A second view is that prayer restrains the worshipper only while the prayer is underway.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r6.anchor: والثاني أنها تنهاه ما دام فيها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r7.speaker: العلماء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r7.claim: A third view takes the verse as saying that prayer ought to restrain its performer from indecency and wrongdoing.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p273#4/r7.anchor: والثالث أن المعنى ينبغي أن تنهى الصلاة عن الفحشاء والمنكر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r3.claim: The command is for the Messenger and believers to recite the Qur'an and convey it to people.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r3.anchor: آمرا رسوله والمؤمنين بتلاوة القرآن، وهو قراءته وإبلاغه للناس

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r4.claim: Prayer includes leaving indecency and wrong, and regular observance leads a person to abandon them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r4.anchor: إن الصلاة تشتمل على شيئين: على ترك الفواحش والمنكرات، أي: إن مواظبتها تحمل على ترك ذلك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r5.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن عمران بن حصين
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r5.claim: A report from Imran says a prayer that does not restrain its worshipper from indecency and wrong is no prayer.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r5.anchor: عن عمران بن حصين قال: سئل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن قول الله: {إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r6.claim: A marfu report from Ibn Abbas says prayer that fails to restrain from wrongdoing only increases distance from God; al-Tabarani transmits it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r7.claim: In a non-Prophetic statement, Ibn Abbas says a prayer that does not command right and forbid wrong only increases distance from God.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r7.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر} قال: فمن لم تأمره صلاته بالمعروف

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن ابن مسعود
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r8.claim: Ibn Masud's marfu report says there is no prayer without obeying prayer, whose obedience is that it restrain indecency and wrong.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r8.anchor: عن ابن مسعود، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r9.speaker: سفيان
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r9.claim: Commenting on Shuayb's people's question in 11:87, Sufyan says prayer indeed commands and forbids.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p280/r9.anchor: قال: فقال سفيان: أي والله، تأمره وتنهاه.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r1.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r1.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet says prayer is not valid for one who does not obey it, and its obedience restrains indecency and wrong; another transmission leaves the attribution to Ibn Masud.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r1.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم -وقال أبو خالد مرة: عن عبد الله -: "لا صلاة لمن لم يطع الصلاة،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r2.speaker: عبد الله
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r2.claim: Ibn Masud says prayer benefits only the person who obeys it; Ibn Kathir judges this stopped report more sound than the Prophetic attribution.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r2.anchor: قيل لعبد الله: إن فلانا يطيل الصلاة؟ قال: إن الصلاة لا تنفع إلا من أطاعها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r3.speaker: الحسن
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r3.claim: Al-Hasan transmits a Prophetic report that a prayer which fails to restrain indecency only increases its performer’s distance from God.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r3.anchor: عن الحسن قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "من صلى صلاة لم تنهه عن الفحشاء والمنكر،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r4.claim: Ibn Kathir judges the stopped reports from Ibn Masud, Ibn Abbas, al-Hasan, Qatada, al-A'mash, and others the soundest.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r4.anchor: والأصح في هذا كله الموقوفات عن ابن مسعود، وابن عباس، والحسن وقتادة، والأعمش وغيرهم،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r5.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r5.claim: A man reports someone prays but steals in the morning; the Prophet replies that what he says in prayer will restrain him. Al-A'mash initially doubts the chain’s link to Jabir.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r5.anchor: قال رجل للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: إن فلانا يصلي فإذا أصبح سرق، قال: "سينهاه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r6.speaker: البزار
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r6.claim: Al-Bazzar says several transmitters relate this report from al-A'mash but differ over its chain, with routes through Abu Hurayra or another authority, Abu Sufyan from Jabir, and Abu Salih from Jabir.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r6.anchor: وهذا الحديث قد رواه غير واحد عن الأعمش واختلفوا في إسناده

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r7.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r7.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the question about a man who prays at night and steals by morning; the Prophet says what the man says will restrain him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r7.anchor: عن أبي هريرة قال: جاء رجل إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: إن فلانا يصلي بالليل فإذا أصبح سرق؟

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r8.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r8.claim: Prayer also contains remembrance of God, its greatest intended element; God knows all people’s sayings and deeds.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p281/r8.anchor: وتشتمل الصلاة أيضا على ذكر الله تعالى، وهو المطلوب الأكبر؛

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r1.speaker: أبو العالية
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r1.claim: Abu al-Aliya says prayer has three necessary traits: sincerity commands right, fear restrains wrong, and Quranic remembrance commands and forbids; a prayer without them is not prayer.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r1.anchor: وقال أبو العالية في قوله: {إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر} ، قال: إن الصلاة فيها ثلاث خصال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r2.speaker: ابن عون الأنصاري
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r2.claim: Ibn Awn says a person in prayer is engaged in good and held back from indecency and wrong; the remembrance of God in which he is occupied is greater.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r2.anchor: وقال ابن عون الأنصاري: إذا كنت في صلاة فأنت في معروف، وقد حجزتك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r3.speaker: حماد بن أبي سليمان
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r3.claim: Hammad explains that prayer restrains a person from wrong for as long as the person remains in prayer.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r3.anchor: وقال حماد بن أبي سليمان: {إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر} يعني: ما دمت فيها.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas says God’s remembrance of His servants is greater than their remembrance of Him; Mujahid and others report this interpretation too.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r4.anchor: قال علي بن أبي طلحة، عن ابن عباس في قوله: {ولذكر الله أكبر} ، يقول: ولذكر الله لعباده أكبر،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r5.claim: In a report about remembering God at meals and bedtime, Ibn Abbas agrees that God’s remembrance of people is greater than their remembrance of Him, citing 2:152.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس: {ولذكر الله أكبر} قال: ذكر الله عند طعامك وعند منامك.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas gives two senses: remembering God with regard to what He forbade, and God’s remembrance of you being greater than your remembrance of Him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r6.anchor: عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس في قوله: {ولذكر الله أكبر} قال: لها وجهان،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas rejects prayer’s praises and Quran recitation as the meaning; it means God’s remembrance of people when they remember Him in obeying commands or avoiding prohibitions, which Ibn Jarir selects.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p282/r7.anchor: عن عبد الله بن ربيعة قال: قال لي ابن عباس: هل تدري ما قوله تعالى:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p283/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p283/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p283/r1.claim: This interpretation is transmitted through several routes from Ibn Abbas and also from Ibn Masud, Abu al-Darda, Salman al-Farisi, and others; Ibn Jarir chose it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p283/r1.anchor: وقد روي هذا من غير وجه عن ابن عباس. وروي أيضا عن ابن مسعود، وأبي الدرداء،

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r1.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r1.claim: One view takes ṣalāh here to mean recitation, supported by the parallel use of ṣalāh for recitation.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r1.anchor: وقيل: أراد به القراءة، ودليله قوله: (ولا تجهر بصلاتك)

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r2.claim: Most exegetes take ṣalāh as the familiar ritual prayer of bowing and prostration; this is correct because a revealed term with a legal sense takes that sense.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r2.anchor: وعليه أكثر المفسرين، وهو الصحيح؛ لأن اللفظ إذا كان له معنى في اللغة ومعنى في الشرع

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r3.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r3.claim: An alternative word order is understood: establish prayer and recite what was revealed, since it restrains indecency and wrong.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r3.anchor: وقيل: فيه تقديم وتأخير تقديره: أقم الصلاة واتل ما أوحي إليك؛ فإنها (تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر)، قيل

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r4.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r4.claim: One explanation says calling people to truth restrains indecency; munkar is sin condemned by reason or religious law.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r4.anchor: قيل: الدعاء إلى الحق ينهى عن الفحشاء، والمنكر المعاصي الذي ينكره العقل أو الشرع

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r5.speaker: ابن عباس وابن مسعود
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Ibn Masʿūd say prayer commands what is right and forbids what is wrong.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r5.anchor: قال ابن عباس وابن مسعود: الصلاة تأمر بالمعروف وتنهى عن المنكر

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r6.speaker: ابن مسعود
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r6.claim: Ibn Masʿūd says prayer benefits only the person who obeys God.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r6.anchor: قال ابن مسعود: الصلاة لا تنفع إلا من أطاعه

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r7.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r7.claim: Prayer is like a speaker forbidding evil: its takbīr, glorification, recitation, and standing before God all call one to leave vice.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r7.anchor: فقيل: لأنها بمنزلة الناهي بالقول؛ لأن فيها التكبير والتسبيح والقراءة والوقوف لله تعالى

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r8.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r8.claim: Prayer restrains indecency for as long as the worshipper is engaged in it.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r8.anchor: وقيل: الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء ما دام فيها

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r9.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r9.claim: The Qurʾān recited during prayer is what forbids indecency.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r9.anchor: وقيل: القرآن الذي يقرأ فيها ينهاه عن الفحشاء

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r10.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r10.claim: Prayer is divine grace that draws a worshipper near and enables restraint when performed humbly; failure to desist is the worshipper’s own fault.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r10.anchor: وقيل: الصلاة لطفه في ترك الفحشاء والمنكر، تقرب العبد، فإن انتهى فهو لطف وتوفيق

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r11.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r11.claim: Another proposed word order makes the revealed recitation itself the subject: it forbids indecency and wrong.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r11.anchor: وقيل: فيه تقديم وتأخير تقديره: أقم الصلاة واتل ما أوحي إليك، فهو ينهى

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r12.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r12.claim: The point may be that a person’s prayer ought to restrain that person, as entering the sanctuary makes one safe.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r12.anchor: وقيل: ينبغي أن تنهاه صلاته كقوله: (ومن دخله كان آمنا)

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r13.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r13.claim: God’s remembrance, including reminders of promise, threat, reward, and punishment, is the strongest grace drawing people to obedience and away from sin.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r13.anchor: قيل: أكبر شيء في النهي عن الفحشاء والمنكرات، يذكر العبد ربه وما ذكر من الوعد والوعيد

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r14.speaker: أبو مسلم
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r14.claim: Abū Muslim interprets the phrase as God’s invocation and remembrance being supreme.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r14.anchor: وقيل: دعاء الله وذكره هو الأعلى، عن أبي مسلم

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r15.speaker: ابن عباس، وابن مسعود، وسلمان، وسعيد بن جبير، ومجاهد، وعكرمة
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r15.claim: These authorities say God’s merciful remembrance of people is greater than their remembrance of Him through obedience; the report is also attributed to the Prophet.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r15.anchor: عن ابن عباس، وابن مسعود، وسلمان، وسعيد بن جبير، ومجاهد، وعكرمة، وروي مرفوعا

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r16.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r16.claim: One explanation contrasts human remembrance as needy and obligatory with God’s remembrance of people as generosity and grace.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r16.anchor: وقيل: لأن ذكر الله على وجه الاستغناء وذكر العبد على وجه الافتقار، ولأن ذكرنا له واجب

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r17.speaker: سلمان، وقتادة، وابن زيد، وأبو الدرداء
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r17.claim: A view transmitted from Salmān, Qatāda, Ibn Zayd, and Abū al-Dardāʾ holds that a servant’s remembrance of God is better than all deeds.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r17.anchor: عن سلمان بخلاف، وقتادة، وابن زيد، وروي ذلك عن أبي الدرداء

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r18.speaker: أبو مالك
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r18.claim: Abū Mālik says remembrance of God within prayer is greater than prayer itself.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r18.anchor: وقيل: ذكر الله في الصلاة أكبر من الصلاة، عن أبي مالك

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r19.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r19.speaker: ابن جرير
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r19.claim: Ibn Jarīr takes God’s remembrance and the prayer being performed as greater than the indecency and wrong that prayer restrains.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r19.anchor: وقيل: ذكر الله والصلاة التي أنت فيها أكبر مما تنهاك عنه الصلاة من الفحشاء والمنكر، عن ابن جرير

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r20.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r20.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r20.claim: One view says God’s remembrance is too great to occur together with sin; another says His remembering people with forgiveness surpasses their verbal remembrance of Him.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r20.anchor: وقيل: ذكر الله لهم بالمغفرة خير من ذكرهم إياه بألسنتهم

JISHUMI:v8p5574/r21.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r21.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r21.claim: God knows the worshipper’s humility in prayer and restraint from all sins, or knows every good and evil deed and will recompense accordingly.
JISHUMI:v8p5574/r21.anchor: قيل: في صلاتكم من الخشوع والانتهاء عن الفحشاء والمنكر وهو جميع المعاصي، وقيل: عليم بما تعملون

JISHUMI:v8p5576/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r4.claim: Prayer’s restraining effect is its rationale as an obligatory divine grace; every grace that turns a person from evil is therefore obligatory.
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r4.anchor: ويدل قوله: (إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر) على أن العلة في وجوب الصلاة

JISHUMI:v8p5576/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r5.claim: The verse teaches the servant to persist in remembering God.
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r5.anchor: ويدل قوله: (ولذكر الله أكبر) أنه ينبغي للعبد أن يديم ذكره

JISHUMI:v8p5576/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r6.claim: God’s knowledge of people’s deeds constitutes a grave threat.
JISHUMI:v8p5576/r6.anchor: ويدل قوله: (والله يعلم) على وعيد عظيم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r1.claim: Prayer gives a person an incentive to leave sins and so functions as though it forbade them.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r1.anchor: الصلاة تكون لطفا في ترك المعاصي ، فكأنها ناهية عنها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r2.claim: Effective prayer requires sincere prior repentance and piety, humble performance in heart and limbs, and protection from being nullified; this is connected to 5:27.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r2.anchor: قلت الصلاة التي هي الصلاة عند الله المستحق بها الثواب : أن يدخل فيها مقدما للتوبة النصوح ، متقيا

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r3.speaker: حاتم
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r3.claim: Ḥātim describes prayer as standing on the bridge with Paradise to the right, Hell to the left, and the angel of death above, between fear and hope.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r3.anchor: فقد روي عن حاتم : كأن رجلي على الصراط والجنة عن يميني والنار عن يساري وملك الموت

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says prayer that neither commands good nor forbids wrong only increases a person’s distance from God.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r4.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : ( 827 ) من لم تأمره صلاته بالمعروف وتنهه عن المنكر

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r5.speaker: الحسن
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r5.claim: Al-Ḥasan says prayer that does not restrain indecency is not truly prayer and becomes a burden against its performer.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r5.anchor: وعن الحسن رحمه الله : من لم تنهه صلاته عن الفحشاء والمنكر ، فليست صلاته بصلاة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r6.claim: Another view is that regular prayer gradually leads a person to leave wrongdoing, even if not at once.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r6.anchor: وقيل : من كان مراعيا للصلاة جره ذلك إلى أن ينتهي عن السيئات يوما ما

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r7.speaker: النبي
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r7.claim: When told of a man who prayed by day and stole by night, the Prophet replied that his prayer would restrain him.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r7.anchor: قيل لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إن فلانا يصلي بالنهار ويسرق بالليل ، فقال : ( إن صلاته لتردعه )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r8.speaker: النبي
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r8.claim: A young Anṣārī who prayed with the Prophet but committed every indecency soon repented after the Prophet said prayer would restrain him.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r8.anchor: أن فتى من الأنصار كان يصلي معه الصلوات ، ولا يدع شيئا من الفواحش إلا ركبه ، فوصف له فقال : ( إن صلاته ستنهاه )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r9.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r9.claim: In any case, someone who attends to prayer is less exposed to indecency and wrongdoing than someone who neglects it.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r9.anchor: وعلى كل حال إن المراعي للصلاة لا بد أن يكون أبعد من الفحشاء والمنكر ممن لا يراعيها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r10.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r10.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r10.claim: The wording does not claim every worshipper is restrained from every vice; as with saying Zayd forbids wrong, it asserts the quality without making it universal.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r10.anchor: واللفظ لا يقتضي أن لا يخرج واحد من المصلين عن قضيتها ، كما تقول : إن زيدا ينهى عن المنكر

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r11.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r11.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r11.claim: One reading says prayer is greater than other acts of obedience and is called God’s remembrance, as in the Friday command in 62:9.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r11.anchor: وللصلاة أكبر من غيرها من الطاعات ، وسماها بذكر الله كما قال : { فاسعوا إلى ذكر الله

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r12.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r12.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r12.claim: Calling prayer God’s remembrance lets the phrase stand as its reason: prayer is greatest because it is remembrance of God.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r12.anchor: وإنما قال : ولذكر الله : ليستقل بالتعليل ، كأنه قال : وللصلاة أكبر ، لأنها ذكر الله

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r13.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r13.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r13.claim: Alternatively, remembering God’s prohibition, threat, and warning when confronted with indecency and wrong is a stronger restraint than prayer’s moral prompting.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r13.anchor: أو ولذكر الله عند الفحشاء والمنكر وذكر نهيه عنهما ووعيده عليهما أكبر ، فكان أولى بأن ينهى

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r14.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r14.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās interprets this as God’s remembrance of you through mercy being greater than your remembrance of Him through obedience.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r14.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما ولذكر الله إياكم برحمته أكبر من ذكركم إياه بطاعته

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r15.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r15.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r15.claim: God knows the good and obedience people do and rewards them with the best reward.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p460/r15.anchor: { والله يعلم ما تصنعون } من الخير والطاعة ، فيثيبكم أحسن الثواب

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r1.claim: The Book is the Quran; this is an address to the Prophet to recite what was revealed to him to his community.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r1.anchor: يعني القرآن وهذا خطاب للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يتلو ما أنزل منه على أمته

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r2.speaker: ابن عمر
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r2.claim: Ibn Umar interprets establish prayer as reciting the Quran.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r2.anchor: أحدها : أنه القرآن , قاله ابن عمر .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets it as the prescribed prayer.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r3.anchor: الثاني : أنه الصلاة المفروضة . قاله ابن عباس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r4.speaker: ابن بحر
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r4.claim: Ibn Bahr interprets prayer here as supplication and the command as calling people to God's cause.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r4.anchor: الثالث : أن الصلاة هنا هي الدعاء ومعناه قم بالدعاء إلى أمر الله , قاله ابن بحر .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses indecency as adultery and wrongdoing as associating partners with God.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r5.anchor: الفحشاء الزنى والمنكر الشرك , قاله ابن عباس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r6.speaker: الكلبي وابن زيد وحماد بن أبي سليمان
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r6.claim: Al-Kalbi, Ibn Zayd, and Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman say prayer restrains a person from indecency and wrongdoing while the person is praying.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r6.anchor: أحدها : أنها تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر ما دام فيها , قاله الكلبي وابن زيد وحماد بن أبي سليمان .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas, through Tawus, reports the Prophet saying that prayer which fails to restrain from indecency and wrongdoing only increases its performer in distance from God.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r7.anchor: روى طاووس عن ابن عباس قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( من لم تنهه صلاته

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r8.speaker: ابن زيد
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r8.claim: Ibn Zayd says the prayer restrains by enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r8.anchor: الثالث : إن ما تدعوهم إليه من الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر ، قاله ابن زيد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r9.claim: Ibn Abbas says God's remembrance of you is greater than your remembrance of Him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r9.anchor: أحدها : ولذكر الله إياكم أكبر من ذكركم إياه , قاله ابن عباس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r10.speaker: سلمان
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r10.claim: Salman says remembrance of God is better than everything.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r10.anchor: الثاني : ولذكر الله أفضل من كل شيء , قاله سلمان .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r11.speaker: عبد الله بن عون
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r11.claim: Abdullah ibn Awn says remembrance of God within prayer is greater than what prayer restrains a person from.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r11.anchor: الثالث : ولذكر الله في الصلاة التي أنت فيها أكبر مما نهتك عنه الصلاة من الفحشاء والمنكر , قاله عبد الله بن عون .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r12.speaker: أبو مالك
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r12.claim: Abu Malik says the servant's remembrance of God in prayer is greater than the prayer.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r12.anchor: الرابع : ولذكر الله العبد في الصلاة أكبر من الصلاة , قاله أبو مالك .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r13.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r13.claim: One view says remembrance of God is too great for human understanding and intellect to contain.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r13.anchor: الخامس : ولذكر الله أكبر من أن تحويه أفهامكم وعقولكم .

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r14.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r14.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r14.claim: Another view says remembrance of God is greater than your acts of obedience to Him.

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r15.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r15.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r15.claim: A final view says remembrance of God is greater than leaving its companion subject to punishment for indecency and wrongdoing.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p284/r15.anchor: السابع : أكبر من أن يبقي على صاحبه عقاب الفحشاء والمنكر .

MUJAHID:v2p495#3/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p495#3/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
MUJAHID:v2p495#3/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says God's remembrance of you is greater than your remembrance of Him.
MUJAHID:v2p495#3/r1.anchor: عن عبد الله بن عبيد بن عمير الليثي عن ابن عباس في قوله ﴿ ولذكر الله أكبر ﴾ قال يقول ذكر الله إياكم أكبر من ذكركم إياه

MUJAHID:v2p495#3/r2.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p495#3/r2.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v2p495#3/r2.claim: Mujahid likewise says God's remembrance of a servant is greater than the servant's remembrance of his Lord in prayer and beyond it.
MUJAHID:v2p495#3/r2.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد قال يقول ذكر الله عبده اكبر من ذكر العبد ربه في الصلاة

MUQATIL:29:44-45/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r3.claim: The Prophet is told to recite the revealed Qur’an to the People of the Book.
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r3.anchor: { اتل ما أوحي إليك من الكتاب } يعنى اقرأ على أهل الكتاب ما أنزل إليك من القرآن

MUQATIL:29:44-45/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r4.claim: Establishing prayer means performing it fully.
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r4.anchor: { وأقم } يعنى وأتم { الصلاة إن الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشآء }

MUQATIL:29:44-45/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r5.claim: Indecency means sins and wrongdoing means what is unrecognized; a person praying to God refrains from them while praying, until finishing.
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r5.anchor: يعنى عن المعاصى { والمنكر } يعنى المنكر ما لا يعرف

MUQATIL:29:44-45/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r6.claim: When one remembers God in prayer, God remembers that person for good; God’s remembrance is greater than the worshipper’s remembrance of Him.
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r6.anchor: { ولذكر الله أكبر } يعنى إذا صليت لله تعالى فذكرته فذكرك الله بخير

MUQATIL:29:44-45/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r7.claim: God knows what people do in their prayers.
MUQATIL:29:44-45/r7.anchor: { والله يعلم ما تصنعون } [آية: 45] فى صلاتكم

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r1.claim: Recite the revealed Book to draw near to God and learn its commands and prohibitions.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r1.anchor: تقربا إلى الله تعالى بقراءة كلامه ولتقف على ما أمر به ونهى عنه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r2.claim: Establish the prayer means to maintain it regularly.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r3.claim: Faḥshāʾ means a vile deed, such as fornication.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r4.claim: Munkar is what religious law and reason condemn.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r5.speaker: النبي ﷺ
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r5.claim: When told of a man who prayed by day but stole at night, the Prophet said that his prayer would restrain him.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r6.speaker: النبي ﷺ
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r6.claim: A young Anṣārī who prayed with the Prophet yet committed every kind of indecency was described to him; he said the man's prayer would stop him, and the young man soon repented.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r6.anchor: أن فتى من الأنصار كان يصلي معه الصلوات ولا يدع شيئا من الفواحش إلا ركبه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r7.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r7.speaker: ابن عوف
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAwf explains that while one is praying, one is engaged in obedience and held back from indecency and evil.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r7.anchor: وقال ابن عوف أن الصلاة تنهى إذا كنت فيها فأنت في معروف وطاعة

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r8.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r8.speaker: الحسن
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r8.claim: Al-Hasan says a prayer that does not restrain its performer from indecency and evil is not prayer, but a burden against that person.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r8.anchor: وعن الحسن من لم تنهه صلاته عن الفحشاء والمنكر فليست صلاته بصلاة وهي وبال عليه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r9.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r9.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r9.claim: One explanation is that prayer surpasses other acts of worship because it is remembrance of God; the wording supplies this reason for its superiority.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r9.anchor: أي الصلاة أكبر من غيرها من الطاعات وإنما قال ولذكر الله ليستقل بالتعليل

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r10.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r10.claim: Ibn Abbas says God's remembrance of people through mercy is greater than their remembrance of Him through obedience.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r10.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما ولذكر الله إياكم برحمته أكبر من ذكركم اياه بطاعته

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r11.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r11.speaker: ابن عطاء
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r11.claim: Ibn ʿAṭā says God's remembrance is greater because it is without cause and does not end, while human remembrance is mixed with motives and wishes and does not last.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r11.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء ذكر الله لكم أكبر من ذكركم له لأن ذكره بلا علة وذكركم مشوب بالعلل والأماني

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r12.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r12.speaker: سلمان
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r12.claim: Salman says remembrance of God is better than anything; he cites the Prophet calling it better than the best deeds, charity in gold and silver, or fighting an enemy.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r12.anchor: وقال سلمان ذكر الله أكبر من كل شيء وأفضل فقد قال عليه السلام ألا أنبئكم بخير أعمالكم

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r13.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r13.speaker: النبي ﷺ
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r13.claim: The Prophet says the best deed is to leave this world while one's tongue remains moist with remembrance of God.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r13.anchor: وسئل أي الأعمال أفضل قال أن تفارق الدنيا ولسانك رطب بذكر الله

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r14.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r14.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r14.claim: Other explanations are that God's remembrance exceeds the grasp of minds, is greater than committing sin alongside it, or restrains indecency and evil more than anything else.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r14.anchor: أو ذكر الله أكبر من أن تحويه أفهاكم وعقولكم أو ذكر الله أكبر من أن تلقى معه معصية

NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r15.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r15.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p260#2/r15.claim: God knows the good and obedience people do and rewards them.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p261/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p261/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p261/r1.claim: God rewards those deeds with the finest reward; this fragment completes the prior segment's explanation of His knowledge and recompense.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r1.claim: Atlu is an imperative to recite and persist in recitation; al-kitāb here means the Qurʾān. The author refers to the warning in Ṭā Hā against turning away and his introduction’s exhortation to read it.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: { اتل } أمر من التلاوة والدءوب عليها. وقد مضى في «طه» الوعيد فيمن أعرض عنها،

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r2.claim: The command addresses the Prophet and his community; establishing prayer means performing it on time with recitation, bowing, prostration, sitting, tashahhud, and all its conditions.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r2.anchor: الخطاب للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وأمته وإقامة الصلاة أداؤها في أوقاتها بقراءتها وركوعها

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r3.claim: The five daily prayers expiate the sins committed between them, as in the Prophet’s analogy of a river washing dirt from someone bathing five times daily.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r3.anchor: يريد إن الصلاة الخمس هي التي تكفر ما بينها من الذنوب كما قال عليه السلام:

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r4.speaker: أبو هريرة
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r4.claim: Abū Hurayra reports the river-and-five-baths analogy for the five prayers washing away sins; al-Tirmidhī transmits it and grades it ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r4.anchor: خرجه الترمذي من حديث أبي هريرة، وقال فيه حديث حسن صحيح.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r5.speaker: ابن عمر
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r5.claim: Ibn ʿUmar says al-ṣalāh here means the Qurʾān; what is recited in prayer forbids indecency, adultery, and sins.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r5.anchor: وقال ابن عمر: الصلاة هنا القرآن. والمعنى: الذي يتلى في الصلاة ينهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر،

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r6.claim: The author connects this use of prayer with the sound prophetic report that prayer is divided between God and His servant, meaning recitation of al-Fātiḥa.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r6.anchor: قسمت الصلاة بيني وبين عبدي نصفين

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r7.speaker: حماد بن أبي سليمان وابن جريج والكلبي
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r7.claim: Ḥammād ibn Abī Sulaymān, Ibn Jurayj, and al-Kalbī say prayer restrains a person from wrong only while he is actually praying.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r7.anchor: وقال حماد بن أبي سليمان وابن جريج والكلبي: العبد ما دام في صلاته لا يأتي فحشاء ولا منكرا

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r8.speaker: ابن عطية
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya calls that reading foreign and contrasts it with the report of a man who prayed yet continued sinning until prayer led him to repent.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r8.anchor: قال ابن عطية: وهذه عجمة وأين هذا مما رواه أنس بن مالك قال:

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r9.speaker: أنس بن مالك
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r9.claim: Anas reports that an Anṣārī youth who prayed with the Prophet still committed indecency and theft; the Prophet said prayer would soon restrain him, and he soon repented and reformed.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r9.anchor: فقال: «إن الصلاة ستنهاه» فلم يلبث أن تاب وصلحت حاله. فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «ألم أقل لكم»

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r10.claim: The author favors the interpretation accepted by authoritative scholars and Sufi elders: establish and fulfill prayer’s bounds; its Qurʾānic admonition, bodily focus, humility, and awareness of God’s gaze reform the worshipper until the next prayer.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r10.anchor: وفي الآية تأويل ثالث، وهو الذي ارتضاه المحققون وقال به المشيخة الصوفية وذكره المفسرون فقيل المراد ب { أقم الصلاة }

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r11.claim: The author adds that imagining each prayer may be one’s last strengthens this effect, since death has no fixed age, time, or known illness.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45/r11.anchor: قلت: لا سيما وإن أشعر نفسه أن هذا ربما يكون آخر عمله، وهذا أبلغ في المقصود

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r1.speaker: بعض السلف
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r1.claim: An unnamed early Muslim reportedly trembled and turned pale when beginning prayer because he stood before God, which he said was even more fitting than trembling before worldly kings.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r1.anchor: وروي عن بعض السلف أنه كان إذا قام إلى الصلاة ارتعد واصفر لونه، فكلم في ذلك فقال:

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r2.claim: Prayer of this kind necessarily restrains wrongdoing; prayer that barely meets requirements without humility, reflection, or virtues leaves a sinner continuing in the same distance from God.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r2.anchor: فهذه صلاة تنهى ولا بد عن الفحشاء والمنكر، ومن كانت صلاته دائرة حول الإجزاء، لا خشوع فيها ولا تذكر ولا فضائل،

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود وابن عباس والحسن والأعمش
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r3.claim: Ibn Masʿūd, Ibn ʿAbbās, al-Ḥasan, and al-Aʿmash transmit that prayer which fails to restrain wrongdoing only increases a person’s distance from God; al-Ḥasan also reports it mursal from the Prophet, but its chain is unsound.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r3.anchor: وعلى هذا يخرج الحديث المروي عن ابن مسعود وابن عباس والحسن والأعمش قولهم:

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r4.speaker: ابن عطية
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya, quoting his father, cautions that a sinner’s prayer is not itself a sin that drives him away; it leaves him unchanged in his sins and distance because it failed to draw him nearer.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r4.anchor: قال ابن عطية: سمعت أبي رضي الله عنه يقول: فإذا قررنا ونظر معناه فغير جائز أن يقول إن نفس صلاة العاصي تبعده من الله

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r5.claim: When told that a certain man prayed much, Ibn Masʿūd replied that prayer benefits only the person who obeys it.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r5.anchor: وقيل لابن مسعود: إن فلانا كثير الصلاة. فقال: إنها لا تنفع إلا من أطاعها.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r6.claim: The author explains the report as saying that a person dominated by vice gains no standing from prayer: it leaves him farther from God and subject to greater displeasure.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r6.anchor: لم تزده من الله إلا بعدا ولم يزدد بها من الله إلا مقتا

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r7.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r7.claim: One view reads the statement as an imperative in meaning: let the worshipper stop wrongdoing; prayer itself does not restrain but is the means that leads him to stop.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r7.anchor: وقيل: هو خبر بمعنى الأمر. أي لينته المصلي عن الفحشاء والمنكر. والصلاة بنفسها لا تنهى، ولكنها سبب الانتهاء.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r8.claim: To illustrate speech attributed to a book or authority, the author links the reading to 45:29 and 30:35.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r8.anchor: وهو كقوله تعالى: هذا كتابنا ينطق عليكم بالحق [الجاثية: 29] وقوله:

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r9.speaker: ابن مسعود وابن عباس وأبو الدرداء وأبو قرة وسلمان والحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r9.claim: Ibn Masʿūd, Ibn ʿAbbās, Abū al-Dardāʾ, Abū Qurra, Salmān, and al-Ḥasan say God’s remembrance of you through reward and praise is greater than your remembrance of Him in worship; al-Ṭabarī chose this view.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r9.anchor: أي ذكر الله لكم بالثواب والثناء عليكم أكبر من ذكركم له في عبادتكم وصلواتكم. قال معناه ابن مسعود وابن عباس

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r10.speaker: ابن عمر
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r10.claim: Ibn ʿUmar transmits the Prophet’s saying that God’s remembering you is greater than your remembering Him.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#2/r10.anchor: وروي مرفوعا من حديث موسى بن عقبة عن نافع عن ابن عمر: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r1.claim: The report’s wording says God’s remembrance of you is greater than your remembrance of Him; Ibn ʿUmar’s attribution was given in the preceding segment.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r1.anchor: ذكر الله إياكم أكبر من ذكركم إياه

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r2.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r2.claim: Another interpretation makes remembrance of God in prayer and Qurʾān recitation better than everything else.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r2.anchor: وقيل: ذكركم الله في صلاتكم وفي قراءة القرآن أفضل من كل شيء

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r3.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r3.claim: Another view says sustained remembrance restrains indecency and wrongdoing more than prayer does.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r3.anchor: وقيل: المعنى إن ذكر الله أكبر مع المداومة من الصلاة في النهي عن الفحشاء والمنكر.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r4.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r4.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says the greatest remembrance occurs when a person leaves something forbidden at the moment he encounters it.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r4.anchor: وقال الضحاك: ولذكر الله عندما يحرم فيترك أجل الذكر.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r5.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r5.claim: One view takes akbar to mean kabīr, so the phrase means that remembrance of God is great in restraining wrong.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r5.anchor: وقيل: المعنى ولذكر الله للنهي عن الفحشاء والمنكر أكبر أي كبير، وأكبر يكون بمعنى كبير.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r6.speaker: ابن زيد وقتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r6.claim: Ibn Zayd and Qatāda say remembrance of God is better than all worship performed without remembrance.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r6.anchor: وقال ابن زيد وقتادة: ولذكر الله أكبر من كل شيء أي أفضل من العبادات كلها بغير ذكر.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r7.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r7.claim: Another view says remembrance prevents sin because someone remembering God does not disobey Him.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r7.anchor: وقيل: ذكر الله يمنع من المعصية فإن من كان ذاكرا له لا يخالفه.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r8.speaker: ابن عطية
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya prefers that remembrance is greater without qualification and itself restrains wrongdoing, in prayer or elsewhere, because abstention requires remembering and watching God.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r8.anchor: قال ابن عطية: وعندي أن المعنى ولذكر الله أكبر على الإطلاق، أي هو الذي ينهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر،

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r9.claim: The author cites the prophetic saying that whoever remembers God privately or in a gathering is remembered by God privately or in a better gathering.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r9.anchor: من ذكرني في نفسه ذكرته في نفسي ومن ذكرني في ملإ ذكرته في ملإ خير منهم

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r10.speaker: ابن عطية
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r10.claim: Prayer movements do not restrain evil by themselves; effective remembrance involves knowledge, an attentive heart, and devotion wholly to God, whereas tongue-only remembrance is a lower rank.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r10.anchor: والحركات التي في الصلاة لا تأثير لها في نهي، والذكر النافع هو مع العلم وإقبال القلب وتفرغه إلا من الله.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r11.speaker: ابن عطية
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r11.claim: God’s remembrance of a servant means that He bestows guidance and the light of knowledge, the fruit of the servant’s remembrance.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r11.anchor: وذكر الله تعالى للعبد هو إفاضة الهدى ونور العلم عليه، وذلك ثمرة لذكر العبد ربه.

QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r12.claim: The verse’s conclusion is a warning and an exhortation to remain mindful of God.
QURTUBI-FULL:29:45#3/r12.anchor: وباقي الآية ضرب من الوعيد والحث على المراقبة.
